question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**cultivates**" means to develop a quality, sentiment, or skill through deliberate effort. (विकसित करता है)
 
• In this context, "cultivates" appropriately fills the blank, indicating that reading literature helps develop empathy by helping us understand the feelings of characters.
 
• The other options: "**withers**", "**avoids**", and "**provokes**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Reading literature not only enhances our language skills but also cultivates__ empathy by helping us understand the feelings of characters.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Withers (मुरझाना)**: means to become dry and shrivel up.
 
• **Avoids (बचना)**: means to keep away from or stop oneself from doing something.
 
• **Provokes (उकसाना)**: means to stimulate or incite someone to do or feel something, especially by arousing anger in them.
